text:
Jordan L: Heads-up — I'm trying to pull up the service overview + model-health dashboards for APAC to investigate a latency spike, but I'm hitting 403 on Grafana. Anyone have the shortlink and/or the right SSO group I should be in?

Kai R: Use this shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/6b8-service-overview?orgId=1&var-region=apac — should land on the APAC view. If you still 403, you probably need the `infra-read-graphs` group.

Maria T: Confirmed 403 here too. Clicking the link redirects to SSO and then back with a 403 page. Error says: "You are not authorized to view this dashboard."

Asha P: Are you accessing from your corp VPN or from home? We had an SSO rule applied for grafana that blocks external sessions unless session-ttl cookie is present.

Jordan L: VPN on. I'm in SF office network. Tried incognito, same result. Screenshot: `403 — You are not authorized to view this dashboard.`

Kai R: Hmm. Two quick checks: 1) Do a curl to see the redirect chain: 
```
curl -I -L -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/6b8-service-overview?orgId=1&var-region=apac
```
It should end 200 if auth ok. 2) Confirm you are a member of the `redwood-apac` SSO group (that maps to infra-read-graphs).

Jordan L: Ran curl — got 403 and final URL is the dashboard path (no token).

Asha P: @infra-bot can you check the mapping for `redwood-apac` -> grafana org roles?

infra-bot: Checked mapping for SSO group `redwood-apac`: role `Viewer` on grafana org 1. Last sync: 2026-02-28 03:15 UTC. Members: list truncated.

Maria T: I see on the admin UI that Jordan L is not in `redwood-apac`. He is in `eng-platform` and `devx`. Might need a one-off add.

Jordan L: Can someone add me to `redwood-apac`? I only need read access for ~2 hours to triage.

Asha P: If you ping SSO group owners we'll get that faster. @sso-bot — create access request for Jordan L -> `redwood-apac` (duration 2h), reason: debug APAC model health latency.

sso-bot: Access request created: ID 3421. Owners notified: @cloud-sso-admins. Link: https://id.redwood.internal/requests/3421

Kai R: Meanwhile, if you need immediate data, you can use the public read-only snapshot of model-health: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d-snapshot/model-health/apac/last-1h — it's delayed by ~5m but no auth needed.

Jordan L: That snapshot works, thanks — can see the model shard error rate spike around 09:12 UTC. Still want live dashboard for tracing.

Maria T: Once you're in `redwood-apac` you'll also be able to open the service-overview dashboard and the region-specific traces links (Jaeger links are on the panels).

Asha P: Owners acknowledged request 3421. If not approved in 10m I'll escalate on pager.

Jordan L: Appreciate it. For the record, could we add a shortline to the internal runbook with the snapshot link and group name? Saved my time.

Kai R: Good idea — I'll open a tiny PR to docs runbook: `docs/observability/grafana-access.md` with the shortlink and the group name.

infra-bot: Access request 3421 approved by @cloud-sso-admins (auto-approved). Jordan L added to `redwood-apac` for 2h.

Jordan L: I can open the dashboard now. Confirmed — everything looks good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Maria T: Nice. Kai — leave that snapshot link in the runbook; we'll tell oncall to use it if SSO flaps.

Kai R: Will do. Closing thread after PR lands.
